## 📊 Impact Assessment
**How severe is this bug?**

- [ ] **Critical** - Platform unusable, data loss, security vulnerability
- [ ] **High** - Major functionality broken, significant user impact
- [ ] **Medium** - Some functionality affected, moderate user impact
- [ ] **Low** - Minor issue, minimal user impact

## 🔍 Additional Context
**Any other context about the problem?**

- Error messages or logs
- Screenshots or recordings
- Related issues or pull requests
- Recent changes that might have caused this

## 🧪 Reproduction Steps
**Can you reliably reproduce this issue?**

- [ ] **Always** - Happens every time
- [ ] **Sometimes** - Intermittent behavior
- [ ] **Rarely** - Hard to reproduce
- [ ] **Unknown** - Haven't tested enough

## 📋 Acceptance Criteria
**What defines this bug as fixed?**

- [ ] Bug no longer occurs
- [ ] No regression introduced
- [ ] Test case added to prevent recurrence
- [ ] Documentation updated if needed
